254:t_020:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「How about it, $n? Now do you get what grown-up power is all about?」

254:t_020:2.en:
$n
「...You really do hold a grudge, don't you.」

254:t_021:0.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Damn you, $$流竜馬$$! Damn you, $$ゲッター$$ Robo!」

254:t_021:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「But this galaxy is our backyard! Don't think the likes of you Earthlings will survive here!」

254:t_022:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those monsters sure are tough to put down.」

254:t_022:3.en:
$$渓$$
「Long time no see! Not that this is a situation for celebrating!」

254:t_022:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I'll take care of the ravenous destroyers. Help me, $$正太郎$$.」

254:t_022:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch...! Still acting so cool, same as ever!」

254:t_022:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You seem as simple as ever too, $$ワッ太$$.」

254:t_022:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Quit talking back like that! We don't have to fight anymore!」

254:t_022:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$グーラ$$! To defeat the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

254:t_022:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We can't let them outdo us! You two ready, $$隼人$$, $$弁慶$$?」

254:t_022:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Monsters that don't know when to give up. Let's finish them off for good.」

254:t_023:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Confirmed: all $$インベーダー#pilot$$s have been annihilated.」

254:t_023:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「And they all lived happily ever after. Case closed...」

254:t_023:2.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Is what I'd like to say, but it won't be that easy, will it.」

254:t_023:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「After all, we've been tossed out into a sea of stars we know nothing about, and we don't even know where we are.」

254:t_023:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$渓$$... Did you get thrown here too?」

254:t_023:6.en:
$$渓$$
「Yeah. We were repairing the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and the $$真ゲッター$$, which got damaged fighting the $$サイデリアル$$, when it suddenly happened.」

254:t_023:7.en:
$$凱$$
「That was a shock. At first I thought the $$ゲッター$$ Reactor had gone out of control.」

254:t_023:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$弁慶$$ and I were there at the time, so we ended up getting caught in it too.」

254:t_023:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「And when we came to, there was nothing but a sea of stars all around.」

254:t_023:10.en:
$$渓$$
「But what a coincidence, huh? Around the same time, everyone in $c got thrown by a $$時空震動$$ to almost the same place.」

254:t_023:11.en:
$$葵$$
「Um... If this is a coincidence, that's insane.」

254:t_023:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... $$渓$$ is the amazing one, writing it off as chance or a fluke.」

254:t_023:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...But still, being able to accept the situation is your strength, isn't it.」

254:t_023:14.en:
$$渓$$
「Thanks, $$グーラ$$. For guiding us when we had no idea which way was up.」

254:t_023:17.en:
$$エイーダ$$
(He has a surprisingly cute side.)

254:t_023:18.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I was only investigating the $$ゲッター線$$ and the ravenous destroyers. You just happened to show up there.」

254:t_023:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「If this is not a coincidence...」

254:t_023:20.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Right... We could say we were guided by the $$ゲッター線$$.」

254:t_023:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't know what the $$ゲッター線$$ wants us to do by pulling a stunt like this, but if it thinks it can move us around for its own convenience, it's dead wrong.」

254:t_023:24.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Maybe that very strength is what the universe seeks...」

254:t_023:25.en:
$$ロビー$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$, we have detected a new black hole reaction.」

254:t_023:26.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Understood. I'll head there at once.」

254:t_024:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Where do you think you're going, $$グーラ$$?」

254:t_024:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I don't recall ever becoming one of your comrades. Our interests happened to align today, so I only fought alongside you.」

254:t_024:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then we'll see each other again, right? We're not enemies anymore...」

254:t_024:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I don't want to see the universe destroyed either. I intend to fight to prevent that.」

254:t_025:1.en:
$$郁絵$$
「But, $$グーラ$$... he did help us.」

254:t_025:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's true. And since we're fighting for the same purpose, I'm sure we'll meet again.」

254:t_025:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is right, $$正太郎$$.」

254:t_025:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「First, let's check the situation with the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$. All units, return to the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

254:t_025:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Roger. Between searching for $n and the others and fighting the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, I'm completely beat.」

254:t_025:7.en:
$$隼人$$
(If it's the $$ゲッター線$$' guidance, as $$グーラ$$ says, then why did it transfer us...)

254:t_025:8.en:
$$隼人$$
(What on earth is in this region of space...? Could $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ being here be connected too...?)

254:t_026:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As the commander of $$チームＤ$$, a thing like this is...」

254:t_026:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thank you for the customary phrase.」

254:t_027:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even in a situation like this, to keep fighting without losing our fighting spirit...」

254:t_027:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Yes. No one here would give in to despair over a mere accident like this.」

254:t_030:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You've still got the skills, both of you!」
